peak_days: Weekends (Friday to Sunday): Very Heavy Crowds. Local day-trippers and weekend tourists pack the hill path. Wait times can easily stretch to 45 minutes to 1 hour.
peak_hours: Between 6:30 PM and 8:30 PM on Sundays.
festival_crowds: Festivals: Extremely packed. Security personnel use barricaded serpentine lines to safely slow down the heavy pilgrim traffic flow.
tips: Weekdays (Monday to Thursday): Highly peaceful and manageable. Ideal for senior citizens and foreign travelers. Wait times for a direct view of the inner deity rarely exceed 15 minutes.
